parameters.query: INSERT INTO client_profile AS cp (bot_id, user_id, display_name, birth_date, sex, height_cm, timezone, units, main_goal, goal_targets, goal_deadline, motivation, disciplines, experience_level, equipment, days_per_week, session_minutes, diet_type, target_kcal, target_protein_g, target_fat_g, target_carb_g, cooking_time_pref, cooking_skill, current_weight_kg, current_weight_on, onboarding_done, onboarding_safety_done, updated_at) SELECT $1, $2, j->>'display_name', (j->>'birth_date')::date, j->>'sex', (j->>'height_cm')::numeric, j->>'timezone', COALESCE(j->>'units','metric'), j->>'main_goal', j->'goal_targets', (j->>'goal_deadline')::date, j->>'motivation', COALESCE(j->'disciplines','[]'::jsonb), j->>'experience_level', j->'equipment', (j->>'days_per_week')::int, (j->>'session_minutes')::int, j->>'diet_type', (j->>'target_kcal')::int, (j->>'target_protein_g')::int, (j->>'target_fat_g')::int, (j->>'target_carb_g')::int, j->>'cooking_time_pref', j->>'cooking_skill', (j->>'current_weight_kg')::numeric, (j->>'current_weight_on')::date, COALESCE((j->>'onboarding_done')::boolean,false), COALESCE((j->>'onboarding_safety_done')::boolean,false), now() FROM (SELECT $3::jsonb AS j) s ON CONFLICT (bot_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.display_name, cp.display_name), birth_date = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.birth_date, cp.birth_date), sex = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.sex, cp.sex), height_cm = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.height_cm, cp.height_cm), timezone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.timezone, cp.timezone), units = CASE WHEN ($3::jsonb) ? 'units' THEN EXCLUDED.units ELSE cp.units END, main_goal = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.main_goal, cp.main_goal), goal_targets = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.goal_targets, cp.goal_targets), goal_deadline = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.goal_deadline, cp.goal_deadline), motivation = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.motivation, cp.motivation), disciplines = CASE WHEN ($3::jsonb) ? 'disciplines' THEN EXCLUDED.disciplines ELSE cp.disciplines END, experience_level = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.experience_level, cp.experience_level), equipment = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.equipment, cp.equipment), days_per_week = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.days_per_week, cp.days_per_week), session_minutes = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.session_minutes, cp.session_minutes), diet_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.diet_type, cp.diet_type), target_kcal = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.target_kcal, cp.target_kcal), target_protein_g = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.target_protein_g, cp.target_protein_g), target_fat_g = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.target_fat_g, cp.target_fat_g), target_carb_g = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.target_carb_g, cp.target_carb_g), cooking_time_pref = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.cooking_time_pref, cp.cooking_time_pref), cooking_skill = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.cooking_skill, cp.cooking_skill), current_weight_kg = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.current_weight_kg, cp.current_weight_kg), current_weight_on = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.current_weight_on, cp.current_weight_on), onboarding_done = cp.onboarding_done OR COALESCE((($3::jsonb)->>'onboarding_done')::boolean,false), onboarding_safety_done = cp.onboarding_safety_done OR COALESCE((($3::jsonb)->>'onboarding_safety_done')::boolean,false), updated_at = now();
